snippet.title: Rooms of War - Launch Trailer | Out Now in Early Access
snippet.description:
Rooms of War is OUT NOW in early access on itch.io for $5.99: https://corruptsectorhq.itch.io/rooms-of-war

Toy-sized soldiers. Full-sized firefights. Teddy bears, garden gnomes, brick soldiers and army men battle across a kid's playroom, a backyard sandbox and the whole backyard. Four classes, three maps, seven modes, team voice chat, and bots fill every match so there's always a fight.

More: https://corruptsectorstudios.com/row
Full trailer: https://youtu.be/L_GhM0agCQc

Corrupt Sector Studios
Music: "Crusader" by Scott Buckley – released under CC-BY 4.0. www.scottbuckley.com.au
